title: One-Hot Detector (No Loops)

forbidden.message: system functions that do the work for you ($onehot, $countones) are not allowed
no loops or generate blocks: solve it with a bit trick

constraints: Purely combinational, no flip-flops or latches.
No loops (`for`, `while`, `loop`, `generate`) and no `$onehot` / `$onehot0` / `$countones`: the judge rejects them.
hints: Subtracting 1 from a number flips its lowest set bit and every zero below it.
`x & (x - 1)` clears the lowest set bit. When is the result zero?
